description: Gazmatek vous présente : Vinyles Rules This one will be maybe the last one at the planet park, this party is made in collaboration with the planet park for support them. We decided to make a party this time only with the best Dj vinyls we know, unfortunately to much dj but we made the best choice we could do for this date. LINE UP We like to surprise you at each event and for this reason we invited 5 artists outside Gazmatek, 2 Dutch artists,1 French artist and 2 Belgian artists. And to keep the surprise complete, these artists will only be revealed on site during the event.
